mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 and may reduce ampicillin levels through enhanced metabolism; ampicillin may increase carbamazepine levels by inhibiting its metabolism and increasing free fraction.
action: Monitor carbamazepine and ampicillin serum levels; consider alternative antibiotic if carbamazepine levels become subtherapeutic; assess for reduced ampicillin efficacy.
